act_title: The Infant Milk Substitutes, Feeding Bottles and Infant Foods (Regulation of Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 1992
title: Offences to be cognizable and bailable
text:
23. Offences to be cognizable and bailable.—Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of

Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), an offence punishable under this Act shall be—

(a) bailable;

(b) cognizable.
